g.text: Synthetic 120 s light curves at 2 Hz with 10 % of frames dropped and a slow phase-angle trend; tumbling periods 4–150 s; 30 % of stable objects
show one glint. Features: spread, amplitude, Lomb–Scargle peak power and period, skewness, kurtosis, flash fraction, autocorrelation at the
period. Trained on 2 400 curves (noise 0.02–0.6 mag); 450 test curves per noise level.
